title: Run an application on the NVIDIA GPU using PRIME offload
summary: Use the prime-run command to launch a specific application on the discrete NVIDIA GPU instead of the integrated one. This is useful for games or 3D applications that need more power.

steps.explain: Run your application prefixed with prime-run. Replace <APP_NAME> with the command you want to run (e.g., steam, blender).

placeholders.name: APP_NAME
placeholders.description: The command to launch the application

verify.expect: The output should show the NVIDIA GPU name, not Intel or AMD.
